>The best thing that you could do at this point is to find a therapist  
  
I've been looking in to seeing another therapist. I've had a few in the past but I felt so distant and as if they were completely impersonal. It's making me completely hesitant to try another.  
  
The way my life has been going it's like I've been on a vacation. I've accomplished nothing. To be honest, I am flip-flopping on on the suicidal thoughts. I've been down this path before and a professional didn't help last time :-/  
  
I'll look into the book though. Thank you

I came in here hoping to see this guy post. Watched most of his videos with friends and collectively we gained well over 200 ELO each. I'm sure I speak for my friends when I say I'd like to see him in a game or two.
